extracted.name: Keto Blueberry Muffins
extracted.description: If you are on keto and having a hard time fighting your sugar cravings, this is a hit without the guilt. Not only does it taste like blueberry cheesecake, but it's a simple and quick recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup sugar substitute. I used all natural erythritol
instruction_lines: In a mixing bowl and using a mixer, beat cream cheese until smooth and creamy
Add the sugar substitute, eggs, xanthan gum and vanilla. Mix until smooth
Using nonstick 12 muffin tin, spoon in the batter. I used 2 tablespoons per muffin tin.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, until top gets slightly brown.
